name: VisIT-Bench-tr
description: A Turkish-language visual instruction / vision–language benchmark that evaluates multimodal models on tasks such as visual question answering and image captioning in Turkish. It assesses how well models follow visual instructions and produce linguistically and visually grounded answers.
evaluation_method: accuracy (automatic metrics for VQA) / human_eval for caption quality
reputation: A targeted dataset for Turkish multimodal evaluation with modest traction in regional/multilingual V&L research.
